proposal.title: Financial reporting relief for wholly-owned companies: ASIC's regulatory burden estimate (Dashboard IA, 2026), re-costed
proposal.description: ASIC remakes its sunsetting class relief (Instrument 2016/785) and measures the change against no instrument, under which each company would apply for individual relief: $3,487 in ASIC fees plus about $1,500 of adviser fees ($5,500 a group of 4–5 companies), for 12,330 companies, once. ASIC counts the whole $5,000; the RBM leaves fees paid to government out (RBM pp. 2, 4). The applications are entered as the current regime because they are what companies would face without the instrument: the Corporations Act's reporting duty stays, so the engine's no-instrument baseline, which drops the current regime's obligations, does not describe ASIC's counterfactual.
